precondition: Both measured update_file calls must present the identical initial_blob_sha. Writer B is not retried with a fresh SHA.

gates.writer_b: update using the same now-stale initial_blob_sha is rejected rather than overwriting writer A

decisions.uncertain: UNCERTAIN_TOOL_BLOCK if writer B is blocked without evidence of a stale-content/API precondition

limits: Sequential stale writer exclusion only; not simultaneous execution, semantic claim validation, distributed locking, or a production lease protocol.
